newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON begins transportation of concentrates.
newsitem.headline: ARCON begins transportation of concentrates.

text.p: ARCON International Resources Plc said on Wednesday that transportation of concentrates from its Galmoy lead/zinc mine had begun at the end of March.
To date, over 20,000 tonnes of concentrates have been produced and sales have been made to its European customers, ARCON said in a statement.
The company also said that ongoing exploration continues to confirm the real prospectivity of the Galmoy licences.

It said its exploration programme in the Galmoy district continues to yield very positive drilling results which exhibit consistent zinc values over economically mineable widths and further confirm the real potential of this metallogenic district.
ARCON also said that due to the success of its original two-year, 1.5 million punt programme, a new exploration programme has been set up for the period to September 1998.
"This programme will focus on ARCON's current exploration work as well as many untested geological targets in the Galmoy district," the company said.
